title: Use logarithmic working memory while paying for full coding and waiting
statement: A streaming weight-one Kraus map removes unnecessary block storage but leaves the full coherent-time and coding resource costs.

evidence.quote: ## 4. The strongest direct implementation uses logarithmic memory
## 5. Why the cubic law holds in every finite dimension

requires: Fix finite dimension d and a time-independent Lindblad generator L(rho)=-i[H,rho]+sum_a(L_a rho L_a^dagger-{L_a^dagger L_a,rho}/2), using a canonical TRACELESS Lindblad family and its associated Hamiltonian. N_t=exp(tL); B_t=N_t^c is the FULL PURE-ENVIRONMENT coherent complementary channel. Alice prepares inputs and may retain a reference; Bob receives the complete coherent environmental output; residual source is discarded. Each use has a fresh environment. LOCC and two-way classical communication are available, with NO initial shared entanglement. Q_two-way is qubits per fresh use. Generator/dimension stay fixed as t decreases; a fixed time unit makes log(1/t) dimensionless. Exact rational-complex/algebraic descriptions support the stated branch tests; physical coefficient/interface acquisition is separate.
provides: Each party stores vacuum or one position1..m. Reject overflow, transfer the first excitation coherently to labelj, and reset the incoming qubit. The exact successful local operator is W_m=sum_j |j-1><e_j|, valid also on inputs entangled with outside references. Accepted histories have identical overflow flags/resets, so discarded registers reveal no position.

A direct reversible C_j X_j C_j swaps only|vac,1> and|j,0>; equality/overflow tests need O(logm) Toffoli/CNOT gates with reusable clean work. Per block/per party: O(logm) working memory, O(m logm) local gates, O(m) overflow measurements. This is ordinary streaming circuitry, not a new compression primitive. Primitive heralds synchronize streams; flags may be exchanged at block end, but all herald latency/coherent waiting remain.

For general d, concentration on m=Theta(t^-2) successful primitives yields an O(t)-close state f_t Phi_m+(1-f_t)*sum_j|jj><jj|/m with f_t->f0>0. A physical phase comparison on two blocks succeeds with constant probability and yields log2m Bell pairs with batch errorO(t). Pairwise twirling permits Pauli errors correlated WITHIN a batch; each fixed position is iid ACROSS independent batches.

Apply the established efficient quantum-expander code row by row. Random-permutation code acquisition and bad-graph probability are charged; no unperformed expansion certification is assumed. For n coding batches, source usesTheta_L(n*t^-3),outputebitsTheta(n log(1/t)),FULL memoryO_L(n log(1/t)),blockworkO(n*t^-2 log(1/t)) plus polynomial codework. General coded output approaches perfect ebits; only the explicit ideal qubit specialization has finite exact pure output.
